_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
3/24 5:45AM - Rise and ride, Stratton! If you’re looking to get in some Tuesday turns, we’re planning to get down on 61 open trails, 60 of which were freshly groomed overnight. Looking uphill, 8 lifts are scheduled to spin at 9AM, and we’re not anticipating any delays. The rail jam setup on Suntanner is sticking around again today, so if you’ve been wanting to get a few laps in, today’s a great day to do it. We’re also expecting the sun to make an appearance, so it should shape up to be a really nice day out there. Let’s get it!

Safety Tip: Stay on the groomed portion of trails.

The Annual Pond Skim is right around the corner and it’s all going down this Saturday, March 28 at 11:30AM. Spots are officially sold out so you’re guaranteed to see some great costumes, big sends, and plenty of “You Got Pickled” moments as riders sink or skim. Even if you’re not skimming, it’s still a fun one to watch with soft spring snow, sunshine, and a full morning of splashes.
